collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A wild piglet has wandered into the encampment and fallen asleep on a Heathen child's mat.

description_variants.description: A wild piglet has wandered into the encampment and fallen asleep on an Isolan child's mat.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A wild piglet has wandered into the encampment and fallen asleep in (subject)'s sleeping mat. (subject) wants to keep it. (friend) does not.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The piglet spends the day following (subject) everywhere. At dusk it hears its mother calling from the bushes and trots off without a backward glance. (subject) is heartbroken for an hour and talks about it for a year.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) carries it gently to the edge of the scrub and sets it down. Its mother is waiting. (subject) watches them go, and decides (subject.he/she) will be a pig-carer when (subject.he/she) grows up.
